parameters.query:
INSERT INTO intel.news_articles (id, ticker, published_at, source, headline, url, summary, sentiment, sentiment_src)
SELECT id, ticker, published_at::timestamptz, source, headline, url, summary, sentiment, sentiment_src
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(id text, ticker text, published_at text, source text, headline text, url text, summary text, sentiment numeric, sentiment_src text)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
INSERT INTO intel.api_usage (run_id, source, endpoint, ticker, status, http_code)
SELECT $2::uuid, 'finnhub', 'company-news', ticker, status, http_code
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb) AS u(ticker text, status text, http_code int);

INSERT INTO intel.news_articles (id, ticker, published_at, source, headline, url, summary, sentiment, sentiment_src, raw)
SELECT id, ticker, published_at::timestamptz, source, headline, url, summary, sentiment, sentiment_src, raw
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(id text, ticker text, published_at text, source text, headline text, url text, summary text, sentiment numeric, sentiment_src text, raw jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET sentiment = EXCLUDED.sentiment, raw = EXCLUDED.raw;
INSERT INTO intel.api_usage (run_id, source, endpoint, ticker, status, http_code)
SELECT $2::uuid, 'alphavantage', 'NEWS_SENTIMENT', ticker, status, http_code
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb) AS u(ticker text, status text, http_code int);

INSERT INTO intel.sentiment_daily (ticker, as_of, news_score, news_count)
SELECT ticker, $2::date,
       round(avg(sentiment) FILTER (WHERE sentiment IS NOT NULL)::numeric, 3),
       count(*)
FROM intel.news_articles
WHERE ticker = ANY($1::text[]) AND published_at >= ($2::date - 7) AND published_at < ($2::date + 1)
GROUP BY ticker
ON CONFLICT (ticker, as_of) DO UPDATE SET news_score = EXCLUDED.news_score, news_count = EXCLUDED.news_count;

parameters.content:
## Input

Called with {run_id, as_of, tickers[], benchmarks[]}. ETFs are skipped.

## Fan out

Top: one item per ticker. Bottom: Alpha Vantage plan, 4 topic calls + holdings + a rotating slice.

## Fetch

Rate-limited HTTP calls. neverError on: a bad reply becomes data, not a crash. Finnhub returns the full response so the status code reaches the ledger.

## Normalize

Rows for intel.news_articles with stable ids so re-runs never duplicate.

## Store

Upserts plus one intel.api_usage row per call: ticker or topic, ok / quota_skip / error, http code.

## Aggregate

Merge waits for both branches, then 7-day sentiment per ticker goes to intel.sentiment_daily and counts return to the caller.

## Collect-News: sources + rules

**Finnhub company-news** (top row): headlines per ticker for the 3 days ending as_of, 1.1 s between calls (60/min free tier). No sentiment on free; rows land with sentiment NULL. id = fh-<ticker>-<finnhub id>, ticker = the queried symbol, so a shared article is kept once per ticker.
**Alpha Vantage NEWS_SENTIMENT** (bottom row): 25 calls/day and a multi-ticker query means ALL tickers (AND), so: 4 topic calls (technology, manufacturing, energy_transportation, financial_markets) + one call per holding + a rotating slice of the rest, 22 calls total. Per-ticker sentiment in [-1, 1]; relevance < 0.1 is dropped. id = av-<ticker>-<hash(url)>. A throttle note is logged as quota_skip, never a crash.
**Aggregate**: after both branches, one SQL rolls the last 7 days of intel.news_articles into intel.sentiment_daily (mean sentiment, article count). Benchmarks (ETFs) never get news.
